title: apm-go Claude marketplace.json (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json)
description: Self-authored schema for apm-go's own ClaudeMapper output (internal/marketplace/build/mapper.go). This is NOT the upstream Claude Code marketplace.json schema (that informational copy lives at testdata/claude-code-marketplace.schema.json) -- it describes exactly the field subset apm-go actually emits. Upstream apm 0.26.0 emits category in its claude marketplace.json (see testdata/upstream-claude-marketplace.golden.json, verbatim from research/eval-real-run-20260728.md:243-261), and apm-go's own ClaudeMapper now emits it too (ClaudePlugin.Category, mapper.go), populated from the curator's marketplace.packages[].category entry -- optional here (not required) since, unlike Codex output, Claude output does not mandate it. remoteSource is split into per-variant oneOf branches (github / url / git-subdir) whose required fields are read directly off composeRemoteSource (mapper.go:214-244): github always sets repo, url and git-subdir always set url, and git-subdir additionally always sets path.

category.description: Curator-declared plugin category, passed through from marketplace.packages[].category (ClaudePlugin.Category, mapper.go). Optional for Claude output (unlike Codex, which requires it via CategoryRequiredError).

remoteSourceGithub.description: composeRemoteSource's default-host variant (mapper.go:233-235): source/repo are always both set.

remoteSourceUrl.description: composeRemoteSource's non-default-host variant (mapper.go:230-232): source/url are always both set.

remoteSourceGitSubdir.description: composeRemoteSource's subdir variant (mapper.go:222-229): source/url/path are always all three set.
